answer: The knoll escrow is released only against a island receipt, and the tide audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 257 aliases means carrying 263 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 24 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
